mathPatches.name: orderflow
mathPatches.description: Calculates volume delta and buyer/seller pressure
mathPatches.code: function(candles) { const len = candles ? candles.length : 0; const delta = new Array(len); for (let i = 0; i < len; i++) { const c = candles[i]; const range = (c.high - c.low) || 0.0001; const buyRatio = (c.close - c.low) / range; const buyVol = (c.volume || 1000) * buyRatio; const sellVol = (c.volume || 1000) * (1 - buyRatio); delta[i] = buyVol - sellVol; } return delta; }

newIndicators.name: 🎯 BTH ICT Silver Bullet & Killzone Matrix
newIndicators.description: Detects 10:00-11:00 AM NY Session FVGs with Auto-Mitigating targets and live HUD.
newIndicators.script: const isSilverBulletTime = session.isin('1000-1100'); const ema20 = ta.ema(close, 20); plot.line({ id: 'ema20', values: ema20, color: '#00F2FE', width: 2, title: '20 Trend EMA' }); const buySignal = ta.and(isSilverBulletTime, ta.crossover(close, ema20)); plot.shape({ id: 'sb_buy', condition: buySignal, shape: 'arrowUp', position: 'belowBar', color: '#00E676', text: '🎯 SILVER BULLET' }); plot.panel({ id: 'sb_hud', title: '🎯 BTH SILVER BULLET RADAR', position: 'top-right', rows: [{ label: 'Killzone Status', value: isSilverBulletTime ? 'ACTIVE 🟢' : 'INACTIVE ⚪', color: isSilverBulletTime ? '#00E676' : '#787B86' }, { label: 'Trend Baseline', value: (ema20[ema20.length - 1] || 0).toFixed(2), color: '#00F2FE' }] });
